notes: Repository of Philippine administrative boundary maps. Main masks use low-resolution geometry derived from PSGC/NAMRIA source shapefiles updated to 31 December 2023. For HUCs omitted from the 2023 province-contained files, the repository's explicitly versioned 2019 low-resolution barangay geometry is used only as a visual boundary fallback; current 2026 PSGC identity/codes are stored separately. All masks are navigation/display geometry, not cadastral or survey-grade boundaries.
